industry.why: Neutral at industry level, carried, with the sector rows carrying a view that moved inside the industry this week: Software B2B Enterprise goes to Neutral on the rotation into software, Semiconductors stays Underweight on the AI capital spending re-pricing, Hardware stays Neutral with the evidence moved against it at the margin. Component 1 regime, 30-Oct-26 (risk-off beneath a steady index, led now by credit and the cost of debt rather than by the artificial intelligence wash-out alone: the US ten-year above 5% after a hawkish Fed hold with two dissents for a hike, Goldman Sachs' Risk Appetite Indicator at its lowest since April 2025, euro investment-grade and high-yield yields up 30 and 90 basis points since September, Brent near $115, the French premium a record 150 basis points, Europe rotating to quality, defensives and non-AI growth, the STOXX Europe 600 1.7% from its high with breadth recovering from the bottom fifth of three years and defensives leading cyclicals at four weeks and three months; sources present 2026-W44): the market has stopped paying for AI capital spending (hyperscaler prints gave no lift, ABB sold on data-centre orders) while demand is intact and sub-sector upgrades continue (memory, equipment, power electronics), and the software-against-semiconductors factor pair is reversing (Goldman Sachs' desk, 26 October). Relative strength per 31-relative-strength.md, 2026-10-30 against 2026-08-28, not week on week: B now, B prior. The industry row stays C because the industry is split by the rotation itself. Counter-case for D: the Nasdaq down 6% in two weeks with momentum down 15% is a regime statement about this industry; for B: the only industry with upgrades inside the sell-off.

sector.why: Neutral, carried, inside a split industry, with the evidence moved against it at the margin. Component 1 regime, 30-Oct-26 (risk-off beneath a steady index, led now by credit and the cost of debt rather than by the artificial intelligence wash-out alone: the US ten-year above 5% after a hawkish Fed hold with two dissents for a hike, Goldman Sachs' Risk Appetite Indicator at its lowest since April 2025, euro investment-grade and high-yield yields up 30 and 90 basis points since September, Brent near $115, the French premium a record 150 basis points, Europe rotating to quality, defensives and non-AI growth, the STOXX Europe 600 1.7% from its high with breadth recovering from the bottom fifth of three years and defensives leading cyclicals at four weeks and three months; sources present 2026-W44): Danske Bank TMT (27 October) says hardware is giving back gains as software works again, though some falls are overdone for names whose demand is mostly outside AI (HMS Networks, 80% outside AI), and the optical and power demand read of last week stands. Relative strength per 31-relative-strength.md, 2026-10-30 against 2026-08-28, not week on week: D now, D prior. One live holding, Hexatronic (4.95%, Technical Momentum B, Fitness 60.3), judged in component 4. Balanced; Neutral by judgement. To D if relative strength falls to F with the rotation into software continuing; to B if the optical demand read is repeated with the shares.

memo.verdict: PARK, medium conviction, explicitly time-boxed to the Q3-26 print on 27-Oct-26 rather than shelved. The memo adopts the risks family's own stated recommendation, quoting it: "Net recommendation is to PARK the Invisio (IVSO.SE) investment case" and "the investment case is officially Parked until the US procurement backlog converts and gross margins stabilize." The adoption is evidence-led rather than deferential: the memo's primary source, the earnings-review family produced 12-Aug-26 covering Q2-26 (reported 17-Jul-26), post-dates the risks family by seven weeks and strengthens the park case, because the order book fell a further 41.7% from its end-2025 level and Q2-26 book-to-bill dropped to roughly 0.54. One material departure: the risks family's park is open-ended, this memo's is time-boxed to one quarter, because the risks family did not have the disclosed fact that the third-party radio contract is 100% fulfilled with zero remaining backlog, which converts its gross-margin failure mode from structural to mechanically self-clearing. Conditions for progression, all observable on 27-Oct-26: Q3-26 order intake above SEK 350m, group gross margin recovering above 56.0%, plus a third condition from the change-forces family that the total order book turn back above SEK 650m. Progress-not-park trigger: a single announced order above SEK 100m before the Q3-26 print, which the risks family names as its own disconfirming item. Kill trigger: a second consecutive intake miss with gross margin failing to clear 56.0%.
case: The memo's central argument is that the company is failing its own published monitoring tests. The change-forces family published five forward tracking thresholds; tested against Q2-26 actuals, three are at or through their warning levels. Order book expected above SEK 750m with warning below SEK 650m: actual SEK 498m, red, a breach 23.4% below the warning line itself. Core gross margin about 60.0% with warning below 56.0%: actual group 53.0%, red, but core roughly 58.0% once the disclosed 5.0 percentage-point radio drag is added back, so amber on the core test. Unannounced intake band SEK 300m to SEK 400m with warning below SEK 250m: actual SEK 279m, amber. Inventory about SEK 300m with warning above SEK 350m: actual SEK 338m, amber. Headcount to about 330 with warning above 350: actual 334, green.

Separately, the business-foundations family named a consecutive two-quarter decline in unannounced order intake as its single early-warning signal. Intake fell from SEK 335m in Q1-26 to SEK 279m in Q2-26, so that signal has fired.

Element E1 (Required input change forces) grades C on a wide split. Required Attribute 1 grades B because the external tailwinds are close to best-available: NATO members formally agreed at The Hague to raise defence spending targets up to 5.00% of gross domestic product by 2035 with 3.50 percentage points ring-fenced for equipment; the European Commission's Readiness 2030 package aims to mobilise up to EUR 800bn by 2030 with the Security Action for Europe facility providing up to EUR 150bn in loans; Germany established a EUR 500bn special fund outside its debt brake; 21 NATO countries reached the 2.00% threshold in 2024. Internal change is real if not a step-change: the margin target was raised from above 15% to at least 20% over time in July 2025, the addressable market was re-scoped from SEK 14bn to SEK 25bn, UltraLYNX was acquired for USD 3.50m and relaunched as the H-Series smart hubs with DNB Carnegie modelling 3,000 units in 2026 at SEK 44,000 each or roughly SEK 130m, and Søren Skou was elected chairman in May 2026 with the board expanded from six to seven ordinary members.
counter_case: The risks family's own recommendation is PARK, quoted in the memo, so the counter-case here runs against the park rather than for it.

The strongest counter is that the gross-margin drag is mechanically and verifiably cleared. The March 2024 third-party radio integration contract is 100% fulfilled with zero remaining backlog, which restores roughly 5.0 percentage points of gross margin with no execution required. The memo records DNB Carnegie expecting group gross margins to recover back toward Invisio's structural benchmark of 59.0% in the second half of 2026 as the sales mix shifts to proprietary systems.
triggers: - Primary dated test: the Q3-26 interim report on 27-Oct-26. Q3-26 order intake above SEK 350m and group gross margin recovering above 56.0% would reverse the park; both are the earnings-review family's own stated invalidation datapoints. DNB Carnegie forecasts Q3-26 order intake of SEK 530m.
- Third progression condition: the total order book turning back above SEK 650m, the change-forces family's own warning line, from SEK 498m currently.

- Progress-not-park trigger: a single announced order above SEK 100m before the Q3-26 print, which the risks family names as its disconfirming item, and which DNB Carnegie frames as the press-released contract announcement required to re-ignite share price performance.

- Kill trigger: a second consecutive intake miss with gross margin failing to clear 56.0%, which the earnings-review family states would signal structural demand loss rather than timing deferrals and require immediate portfolio reassessment; the sceptical case is that this forces a further 15% to 20% round of earnings-per-share cuts and price targets toward SEK 200.

- Monitoring between now and then: order announcements and the monthly unannounced-intake run rate against the SEK 300m to SEK 400m band and the SEK 250m warning; book-to-bill against the near-1.00 disconfirming test.

- Open at Element E1: rebuild the multiple read from a non-stale valuation feed before any Early-Stage Assessment, since the dashboard valuation block is flagged stale and the percentile's comparison basis is undisclosed.
